title: fix(fields,types,app-shell): the lookup widget reads allowCreate, lookupColumns and lookupPageSize alone; the snake_case twins retire (objectui#12157)
body:
Fixes #12157
Clause-②: yes

## What this changes

`LookupField` read `allow_create`, `lookup_columns` and `lookup_page_size` FIRST, ahead of the keys `@objectstack/spec`'s `FieldSchema` declares: `allowCreate`, `lookupColumns`, `lookupPageSize`. That is the second spelling objectui `AGENTS.md` #0.1 forbids. Following triage's direction on this card (comment `6112544498`), the three snake legs are retired with no alias, on the ground objectui#11070 round 6 retired `display_field`: the ingestion fold (`normalizeSchemaReferenceKeys`, objectui#7650 ruling A) stamps a stored snake spelling onto its declared key for every object `ObjectStackAdapter.getObjectSchema` serves and `MetadataProvider` stores.

| FROM | TO |
|---|---|
| `allow_create` | `allowCreate` |
| `lookup_columns` | `lookupColumns` |
| `lookup_page_size` | `lookupPageSize` |

- **Readers (`@object-ui/fields`, minor).** `LookupField` reads the three camelCase keys alone. `resolveActionParams` retires its `lookup_columns` / `lookup_page_size` legs in the field-backed lookup extras, and its field-like input type (`RuntimeField`) drops both snake members.
- **Producers (`@object-ui/app-shell`, patch).** `paramToField` emits `lookupColumns` / `lookupPageSize`. The flow designer's directory record-lookup cell (`ReferenceCombobox` in `FlowReferenceField.tsx`) hands the widget `allowCreate: false`.
- **Types face (`@object-ui/types`, minor).** `LookupFieldMetadata` declares `allowCreate`, `lookupColumns` and `lookupPageSize`, each typed by reference to the spec member (`SpecField['allowCreate']` and so on, as `form.ts` does), and no longer declares the three snake members. Its docblock teaches the camelCase keys. A typed producer that writes a snake key is now an excess-property error, so the type cannot declare a key the widget ignores.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx` teaches the camelCase keys in the typed example, the Record Picker example and the feature lists, and adds one paragraph that names the retired spellings and the fold.
- **Changesets.** One `.changeset/12157-*.md` per touched published package. The `fields` and `types` changesets state FROM → TO and the break for a host that hands in unfolded objects.

## Files beyond the claim's list, and why

The claim's surface covered the five source files, the types member, the docs page and "the tests and fixtures that spell these three keys". Measured with `git grep` on `main` `26b0bd2`, the retirement also needs these:

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/relationalMetaKeys.ts`: `RELATIONAL_META_READ_SET` recorded `allow_create`, `lookup_columns` and `lookup_page_size` as read by `LookupField`. The derivation test's orphan check fails on a row whose read is gone, so the three rows go. The copy set (`RELATIONAL_META_KEYS`) does not change. The derivation test's two-spelling positive control moves from the `lookup_columns` / `lookupColumns` pair to `avatar_field` / `avatarField`; both spellings are still required.
- `examples/schema-catalog/test/form-field-channel-census-12130.test.tsx`: the census ledger rows for the three keys go, for the same reason (the census turns red on a ledger row whose read is gone).
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/fieldEnrichment.ts`: `ENRICHED_FIELD_METADATA_KEYS` copied the three snake keys onto the inline-edit field; after this change nothing reads them. Removed in place under the bounded-fix rule: same defect class, the shape objectui#7155 used for its own retired keys in the same list, no other claim on the file, and the plugin-detail suite runs anyway because the types face changed.
- Comment-only re-spellings of `lookup_columns` → `lookupColumns` in `RecordPickerDialog.tsx`, `deriveLookupColumns.ts`, `lookupColumnDisplay.tsx` (its "`lookup_columns` / `lookupColumns`" dual-spelling sentence was made false by this change) and three fields test docblocks.

Not touched, as the claim excludes: `reference_field`, `title_format`, `avatar_field` (and `user.mdx`), the fold in `packages/core`, and objectstack's `FieldSchema` docblock. No hit for the three keys under `skills/**` (measured: `git grep` exit 1 for the keys; control `lookup|reference` over `skills` exit 0, 5 files). No package `README.md` names them.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

- **B1, the fold, by a run.** Each of the three snake keys, written alone on a field def and passed through `normalizeSchemaReferenceKeys`, gains its camelCase key by reference, and the folded def draws exactly what the camelCase def draws: the declared picker columns and page size, and no quick-create. Pinned in `LookupField.snakeLegsRetired-12157.test.tsx` ("the SAME snake def, folded at ingestion, ...") and, for the action-param path, in `resolveActionParams.remainingLookupLegs-7435.test.ts` ("the SAME def, folded at ingestion, reaches both exits with its stored values"). All three keys fold, so all three legs retire.
- **B2.** Held: `paramToField` was the in-repo producer of `lookup_columns` / `lookup_page_size` on the widget bag. It moves with the reader. The pins that asserted the old spelling were re-spelled (`paramToField.test.ts`, `expandableFamily.identity-5874.test.ts`, the exit-2 cases of the 7435 file). The "a `lookup_columns`-only def still reaches the picker" pair asserted the deleted branch, so it is replaced, not re-spelled: an unfolded snake-only def now reaches neither exit, and the same def folded reaches both.
- **B3.** Held: with the producer on `allowCreate: false` and the snake leg gone, a user-facing reference offers no quick-create. `allow_create: false` handed in unfolded no longer opts out, which is why the producer had to move.
- **B4.** Of the packages `git grep` names for `LookupFieldMetadata`, code reads its members only in `fields` (`cascadeMeta.dependsOn`), `types` (`form.ts` takes `idField` by reference) and `app-shell` (the `FlowReferenceField` literal). The `core`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-grid` and `plugin-tree` hits are comments and docblocks. Their type-checks were run anyway (below).
- **B5.** Held, both retired in the same change.
- **B6.** No `skills/**` hit.

## Pins

- `packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.snakeLegsRetired-12157.test.tsx` (new): renders the real widget against a bare control def, and reads the browse-all picker's columns, its query's `$top` and drawn rows, and quick-create on an empty result. The camelCase def differs from bare; the unfolded snake def reads exactly as bare; the folded snake def reads exactly as camelCase.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/lookup-field-metadata-spec-spelling-12157.test.ts` (new): type-level equality with the spec members, absence of the snake members, a `@ts-expect-error` per snake key, and the installed spec's accept/refuse verdicts with lit controls.
- `FlowReferenceField.lookup.test.tsx`: the picker hands the widget `allowCreate: false` and no `allow_create`.
- Fixture triage: `complex-widgets.test.tsx` and `LookupField.pickerAgreement.test.tsx` re-spelled; the 7435 snake describe replaced (above).

## Tests and gates

Run on `bb91e21` unless the row says `9c6837c`. The only commit between them retypes the new fields pin's test backend without `any`; that file and the fields type-check were re-run at `bb91e21`. Each vitest, type-check and build run went through the shared verify lock. Single-command runs printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`; the two multi-package type-check batches printed each part's own exit code (all 0) beside the lock's `batch-last-exit 0`.

## Reverse verification

Each leg mutated a committed tree through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode (the anchor must hit once, the blob must change, a trap restores on exit). Every restore was proven by blob hash equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The direction was red in every leg, as expected.

| Mutation | Run | Result |
|---|---|---|
| A. the three `??` snake legs back in `LookupField` | the new fields pin | 2 failed, 6 passed: the two "handed in UNFOLDED" cases |
| B1. the two snake legs back in `resolveActionParams` | the 7435 file | 1 failed, 6 passed: "handed in UNFOLDED reaches neither exit" |
| B2. `paramToField` emitting the snake keys again | the 7435 file and `paramToField.test.ts` | 6 failed, 21 passed |
| C. the flow picker on `allow_create: false` again | `FlowReferenceField.lookup.test.tsx` | 1 failed, 11 passed |
| D. `LookupFieldMetadata` back on the three snake members | `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` in `packages/types` | exit 2, 8 errors, all in the new types pin (TS2339 ×3, TS2344, TS2561, TS2578 ×3) |
| E. `allow_create: true` back in the `lookup.mdx` typed example | `pnpm check:doc-snippets` | exit 1, TS2561 on that fence: "Did you mean to write 'allowCreate'?" |
| F. the flow picker on `allow_create: false`, against the new type | `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/app-shell` | exit 2, TS2561 naming `allow_create` on `LookupFieldMetadata` |

## Declared narrowings and NOT MEASURED

- **app-shell suite, narrowed.** 128 of its 1287 test files: every app-shell test file whose source names `paramToField`, `ActionParamDialog`, `FlowReferenceField`, `resolveActionParams`, `LookupField`, `lookupColumns`, `lookupPageSize`, `allowCreate`, `fieldEnrichment` or `relationalMetaKeys`, which includes every touched app-shell test. Blind spot: a test that reaches those modules through another module without naming any of them. The full suite did not fit the container's ten-minute foreground cap (`packages/fields/` alone, 249 files, held the lock 381 s). CI runs it whole.
- **eslint, narrowed.** `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 24 touched `.ts` / `.tsx` files: 24 files judged, 0 errors. The 175 warnings are on pre-existing lines; the new fields pin has 0 after `bb91e21`. The root `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on a file it does not touch. `pnpm lint` itself belongs to CI.
- NOT MEASURED: the full app-shell suite (reason above).

## Patch round 1

**Patch round 1.** The branch merged `main` at `9646e2e` (merge commit `3e5cfb9`). Then `81324c0` corrects one bullet of the pending `.changeset/12130-form-field-channel-keys.md`, which this PR made false. The four snake spellings stay refused by name. The bullet's reason clause now says the `lookup` widget no longer reads `allow_create`, `lookup_columns` and `lookup_page_size` (retired here) and still reads `reference_field` behind `displayField`. The rest of that file is byte-identical, and its declaration (`@object-ui/types: minor`) is unchanged. The claim amendment is `6121216484`. Gates on `81324c0`, exit 0 each: `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `changeset:check`, `check-changeset-presence` (23 source files of 5 released packages, 5 changesets), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite` (report-only by design: it lists this one touched changeset, declared `@object-ui/types: minor` both before and after), `check:new-line-citations` (0 new) and `check:control-bytes`.

## Acceptance notes (observed, not filed)

- Same family, not in this card's three keys: `resolveActionParams` still reads `description_field` and `lookup_filters` behind `descriptionField` / `lookupFilters`, and the Studio field inspector (`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`) reads `lookupFilters ?? lookup_filters`. Both camelCase keys are `FieldSchema`-declared and the fold covers both (pinned in the core suite). No in-repo producer of either snake spelling was found. Carrier: none (no reach). Noted, not filed.
- `LookupField.pickerAgreement.test.tsx` still writes `display_field: 'name'`, a spelling objectui#11070 round 6 retired. Nothing reads it; the case passes on the default display field `name`. Carrier: whoever next edits that test. Noted, not filed.
- The pending `.changeset/12130-form-field-channel-keys.md` said the lookup widget "still reads" `allow_create`, `lookup_columns` and `lookup_page_size`, which this PR makes false before both changesets reach the same release. It is corrected in patch round 1 (see that section above), under claim amendment `6121216484`.
- objectstack's `FieldSchema` docblock ("SNAKE_CASE TOLERANCE") goes stale with this change, as the claim foresaw, and so do three `packages/spec/liveness/field.json` notes. The seat filed both as objectstack-ai/objectstack#23012. That card unlocks once the console pin covers this merge.
- `ROADMAP.md` carries two completed entries that name `lookup_columns` / `lookup_page_size` as schema config (seen by the contract review). It is repo-internal and unpublished. Carrier: none. Noted, not filed.
